description: Defines the BuzzShare entity class for the OrangeHRM system, representing social media share posts with properties like post reference, employee, likes, comments, type, text, and timestamps.

classes.name: BuzzShare
classes.description: Entity class representing a social media share post within the OrangeHRM system, including properties for post details, employee, likes, comments, type, text, and timestamps.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the BuzzShare entity.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the BuzzShare entity.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Returns the Employee who created the share.

methods.name: setEmployee
methods.description: Sets the Employee who created the share.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of share (post or share).

methods.name: getText
methods.description: Returns the text content of the share.

methods.name: setText
methods.description: Sets the text content of the share.

methods.name: getCreatedAtUtc
methods.description: Returns the creation timestamp in UTC.

methods.name: setCreatedAtUtc
methods.description: Sets the creation timestamp to current UTC time.

methods.name: getUpdatedAtUtc
methods.description: Returns the last update timestamp in UTC.

methods.name: setUpdatedAtUtc
methods.description: Sets the last update timestamp to current UTC time.
